name: GRU Volume Fusion
definition: A recurrent neural network that incrementally fuses local feature volumes $\{V_t\}$ per frame into a global volume $V^g$ using GRUs with sparse 3D CNNs.
summary: GRU Volume Fusion incrementally fuses local radiance fields into a global sparse field by adaptively updating only covered voxels, enabling real-time incremental scene reconstruction.
